title: Architecture Invariant Audit for Canonical Restart Recomposition
scope: exact two-file F-MR21 restart recomposition on F-CI24 current canonical source

invariants.01_single_calculation_kernel: PASS_UNCHANGED; restart restores canonical committed state and does not introduce a second physics kernel.
invariants.02_kernel_separate_from_IO: PASS; restart carrier is serialization-neutral and no file/path/parsing dependency is introduced into kernel or restart runtime.
invariants.03_explicit_data_separation: PASS; template/parameter references, committed state and provenance remain separately represented.
invariants.04_compact_persistent_state: PASS; records contain continuation state/provenance only and reuse parameter references.
invariants.05_scratch_per_worker: PASS; no Newton/Jacobian/constitutive scratch is added to persistent restart records.
invariants.06_scalable_memory_layout: PASS_NOT_RESTRICTED; registry-oriented many-column restore is preserved and no per-column heavy solver instance is added.
invariants.07_transactional_timesteps: PASS; only committed-boundary state is exported/restored and whole-registry restore is atomic on validation failure.
invariants.08_cheap_recompute_and_warm_start: PASS_UNCHANGED; restored committed state is a valid continuation base and no trial state is promoted as committed state.
invariants.09_generic_time: PASS; exact non-calendar committed times are preserved and generic time-window tests pass.
invariants.10_flexible_coupling_windows: PASS_UNCHANGED; no day-boundary assumption is introduced and generic committed times remain representable.
invariants.11_coupling_core_functionality: PASS_UNCHANGED; transactional committed-state semantics required by coupling are preserved, without claiming MODFLOW coupling qualification.
invariants.12_explicit_groundwater_interface_contra: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; restart does not alter head/flux interface semantics and makes no coupling-interface claim.
invariants.13_absolute_mass_conservation: PASS_IN_SCOPE; interval mass continuation and continuous-versus-restarted endpoint identity pass exactly.
invariants.14_interface_sensitivities_first_class: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; no sensitivity output or Jacobian ownership is changed.
invariants.15_limit_coupling_cost: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; restart adds no repeated physics solves to the normal coupling path.
invariants.16_multiswap_primary_use_case: PASS_IN_SCOPE; many-column batch sizes 1,2,7,8,17,31,32 pass with identity preserved.
invariants.17_no_required_one_to_one_MODFLOW_relati: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; restart operates on logical columns and does not encode MODFLOW cell ownership.
invariants.18_deep_vadose_optional_external_compone: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; no deep-vadose state or routing semantics are introduced.
invariants.19_mass_conserving_component_transition: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; no component transition is added; committed water-state identity is preserved.
invariants.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers_open: PASS; generic restart layer is physics-type agnostic and state-family admission is explicit rather than hard-coded from payload inference.
invariants.21_maximum_SWAPPHYSICS_reuse: PASS_UNCHANGED; no physical process implementation is duplicated.
invariants.22_no_other_modules_coupled_to_HeadCalc_: PASS; restart uses typed committed-state/runtime contracts and introduces no HeadCalc internal-array dependency.
invariants.23_physics_options_separate_from_solver_: PASS; template state-family/layout validation remains explicit and no numerical policy changes physical options.
invariants.24_predictable_runtime: PASS_BOUNDED_IN_SCOPE; registry validation is finite and fail-closed before atomic publication; no fallback policy is changed.
invariants.25_reference_mode_available: PASS_UNCHANGED; reference runtime remains intact and restart qualification is against that canonical source.
invariants.26_runtime_diagnostics: PASS_UNCHANGED; existing diagnostics are preserved; restart does not remove mode/retry/mass diagnostics.
invariants.27_optional_functionality_scales_with_us: PASS; restart state-family support is registered/template-scoped and no optional state is added to inactive columns.
invariants.28_runtime_coupler_organizes_system_comp: PASS; restart registry/template composition remains in runtime and no tile/MODFLOW/deep-vadose relation enters the kernel.
invariants.29_no_silent_dependencies: PASS; state family, layout, parameter identity, provenance and committed time are explicit and invalid combinations fail closed.
invariants.30_every_architecture_change_explicitly_: PASS; exact source locks, owner O0/O2 matrix, negative attacks, mass/identity gates and independent F-CI26 requalification are recorded.

scope_boundaries: canonical promotion requires separate F-CI governance
